d.title: Kanzen Mushuusei: Sorezore no Houkago
d.jp: 完全無修正 それぞれの放課後
d.synopsis: Four friends at school. Three of them get caught up in having sex with older men. Two of them prostitute themselves to a middle-aged man while the other girl is caught masturbating at her teacher's desk. Do these girls really know what they've getting themselves into?
